The passage from Polybius (τυχὸν ... ἀτρυφῆ) is illegible in its middle and is marked as such. Catchword: none visible. The word "Falsi" at the end is printed as "Falfi" (long s); it is given here as a plain s. The line "Falfi fufpe-" is the last full line and is a hyphenated break, so it stays as printed.
